title: AI in Augmented Reality (AR) - guided liver surgery: Acquisition of data for the research on algorithms for AR-guided liver surgery (AIiAS - data study)
summary: In this study, short video data (5min) of the abdomen will be recorded during an open surgery. These data will be used to explore methods to find and track the liver in live camera data of a surgery (tracking). This could subsequently be used to make virtual overlays (augmented reality) on the organ, informing the surgeon about the location of blood vessels and tumors and thus supporting the intervention.

interventions.name: Prospective cohort study of approximately 60 patients, older than 18 years, undergoing open surgery of the stomach, pancreas, or liver. In all these cases, the surgical opening is the same and so is the view of the liver. Patients who are not capable of giving consent themselves are excluded.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Included are all patients older than 18 years who receive open surgery on the stomach, pancreas or liver. In all these cases, the surgical opening is the same and so is the view of the liver.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who are not able to give consent themselves are excluded from the study.
